# Rapid7 Report: Human Operators Still Drive Most of Tracked Cyberattacks, but Exploitation Windows Are Narrow


Attacker adoption of agentic AI is lagging the technology, but adversaries are already exploiting high-severity vulnerabilities in an average of just three days, leaving defenders a narrow window to reduce exposure.
